title: Raman gain efficiency, effective area and attenuation of transmission-fiber types: reference data with provenance
model: none for the model cards (reference data). tables_bands.py uses the entries only for the fiber-type table: area-scaled gain efficiencies (derived) and undepleted on-off gains (computed)

device.host: silica fibers of ITU-T classes G.652.D, G.655 and G.654.E

notes: Only values traced to a data sheet, a paper or the GNPy repository are stored. C_R is the peak Raman gain efficiency g_R/A_eff,R for (depolarized) pumping near 1450 nm, with A_eff,R = [A_eff(pump) + A_eff(Stokes)]/2, which is close to A_eff(1550 nm) (OFS white paper). Values marked 'derived' are area-scaled from the SSMF entry and are NOT measurements. Typical C_R values of DCF, HNLF and G.653 fibers were not traced to a source in this work and are therefore not stored. [OFS06] = T. Geisler, B. Palsdottir, Selecting the right NZDF fiber for distributed Raman amplification, OFS Fitel Denmark white paper (Copyright 2006 Furukawa Electric North America), lightera.com/wp-lightera/NZDF-for-Distributed-Raman-Amplification.pdf (read 17 Nov 2026). [LIG] = Lightera product page 'TrueWave REACH Optical Fiber' (product marked discontinued), lightera.com/?p=1008655 (read 17 Nov 2026). [Y] = J. Yang et al., ECOC 2025 (UCL Discovery 10217063). [P] = Puttnam et al., J. Lightwave Technol. 43(23), 10371-10379 (2025). [GNPy] = oopt-gnpy master (read 17 Nov 2026).

dra_u_fibers_P.value: 1 km HNLF (about 1 dB insertion loss), 8 km IDF (about 3 dB), 0.51 km HNLDSF (about 1.5 dB); pump 2, 1.6 and 2.1 W; HNLF: 22.3 dB net gain at 1646 nm for -8 dBm input, NF 4.2 dB (1646 nm) to 5.8 dB (1626 nm)
dra_u_fibers_P.applies_to: discrete Raman amplifiers of the U-band (device-level data; the C_R of these gain fibers is not reported)

onoff_pump_W.applies_to: single counter-propagating pump of the on-off gain column (undepleted closed form)

onoff_span_km.applies_to: span length of the on-off gain column

source.basis: 1240 nm: O-band Raman pumps of [P] (1220-1250 nm); 1345 nm: pumps between O- and E-band of [P] (1340, 1350 nm); 1454 nm: GNPy reference; 1550 nm: pumps for U-band signals

cr_eval_pump_nm.applies_to: pump wavelengths at which the peak SSMF efficiency is evaluated with the GNPy scaling rule (derived values, not measurements)

rule_area.value: C_R = g_R / A_eff,R with A_eff,R = [A_eff(lambda_p) + A_eff(lambda_s)]/2 ~ A_eff(1550 nm); g_R depends on the glass composition

source.ref: [OFS06]; K. Rottwitt et al., Scaling of the Raman gain coefficient: applications to germanosilicate fibers, J. Lightwave Technol. 21(7), 1652-1663 (2003), doi:10.1109/JLT.2003.814386
